excerpt: A functional group characterized by a carbonyl group flanked by two carbons of any hybridization.

reviewedMappings.2026-3-11:0: Carbonyl must have carbon on both sides. With five noncarbonyl carbons only unordered positive splits 1+4 and 2+3 are possible. Independently enumerate C4 rooted alkyl groups n/sec/iso/tert (4) and C3 n/iso (2), total 6. Explicit condensed formulas supplied in choice 3.
